title: Meteors
description: A night sky for a hero: meteors streak across a dark panel on their own schedules.
usage: A background, not a foreground: the stage is a dark panel and the script seeds about fourteen meteors with random starts, delays and speeds, forever. Put one short line of type over it and stop — a sky with a paragraph on it is weather, not design.
a11y: Pure decoration: the meteors are aria-hidden and the words over them are ordinary text. Under prefers-reduced-motion the sky goes still and the meteors hide — the panel and the message remain.
